Orascom.desc: Orascom Construction PLC is an engineering and construction contractor that builds infrastructure, industrial and commercial projects in the Middle East, Africa and the United States, and owns 50% of BESIX Group. It is listed on both the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange and the Egyptian Exchange (ticker ORAS), with revenue of US$5.06 billion in the year to 31 December 2025.

West African Gas Pipeline Company (WAPCo.desc: WAPCo is a limited liability company in Accra that owns and runs the West African Gas Pipeline, which carries natural gas through Nigeria, Benin, Togo and Ghana on an open-access basis. It is a joint venture of public and private companies: Chevron West African Gas Pipeline Ltd (36.9%), Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation (24.9%), Shell Overseas Holdings (17.9%), Takoradi Power Company (16.3%), and 2% each for Societe Togolaise de Gaz and Societe BenGaz.

Shell.desc: Shell plc is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, with about 85,000 employees in more than 70 countries. It reports under the UK Listing Rules and files a Form 20-F with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.

sources.title: Shell plc publishes 2024 Annual Report and Accounts

Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation.desc: NNPC is Nigeria's national oil company, working across oil production, gas processing and liquefied natural gas, refining and petrochemicals, and low-carbon investments including solar and biofuels. It was formed on 1 April 1977 by merging the operations of the Nigerian National Oil Corporation with the regulatory functions of the Federal Ministry of Mines and Power, and became a limited liability company, NNPC Ltd, under the Petroleum Industry Act in August 2021; members of its board represent the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Petroleum Resources.

Chendar Plywood.desc: A Cambodian timber concession company, named in the report as Cambodia Cherndar Plywood and cutting trees in Cambodia in 2001 and 2002. Global Witness's 2002 review lists it among concession companies in breach of their contracts, drawing on the Asian Development Bank's 2000 concession review, and records no owner, concession area or province for it.

Samraong Wood.desc: Samrong Wood was a Cambodian logging company holding a timber concession in northern Siem Reap and Oddar Meanchey provinces. Its 2001 harvest was 10,794 cubic metres of logs; the Global Witness review that documents it records no owner.

Everbright CIG Wood.desc: A Cambodian timber concession company. Global Witness's 2002 review lists Everbright among concession companies in breach of their contracts, drawing on the Asian Development Bank's 2000 concession review, with no payment in the second or third year, and records no owner, concession area or province for it.

Pheapimex.desc: Pheapimex Fu Chan Co. Ltd is a Cambodian company holding logging and economic land concessions, described by Global Witness in 2002 as the country's largest forest and land concessionaire with 1,023,753 hectares, with logging in Kompong Thom and Stung Treng and a veneer factory in Kandal. It is co-owned by Lao Meng Khin, a senator for the ruling Cambodian People's Party, and his wife Choeung Sopheap.

Ganadera Bocas S.A..note: Searched for the company in Spanish and English alongside Bocas del Toro, San San Druy and the Naso; no company register entry, company site or news report naming Ganadera Bocas S.A. could be opened. Panama's public register was not reachable with the tools available.

DTV Contractors.note: Searched for DTV Contractors with the Ijora/Lagos drainage project and on its own; no company site, Nigerian corporate-register entry or news report about the firm could be opened.

ACLEDA Bank.desc: ACLEDA Bank Plc is a Cambodian commercial bank offering loans, deposits, payments, foreign exchange and digital banking to individuals and businesses, with subsidiaries in Laos and Myanmar and 321 group offices across the three countries. It was the first commercial bank listed on the Cambodia Securities Exchange; its biggest named shareholder is the ACLEDA Financial Trust, with 28.3% in 2024, and group assets were about US$10.8 billion at the end of 2024.

Amret Microfinance Institution.desc: Amret is a Cambodian microfinance lender making small loans and taking deposits, with more than 630,000 clients and a balance sheet approaching US$2 billion. The Advans Group was a shareholder from 2005 and held 56% until it sold that stake to Taiwan's Bank SinoPac.

sources.title: The Advans Group Announces the Closing of the Sale of its Stake in Amret to Bank SinoPac

Hattha Bank.desc: Hattha Bank Plc is a Cambodian commercial bank lending mainly to retail customers and small businesses and taking deposits, with 177 branches and total assets of US$1.58 billion at the end of 2020. It is wholly owned by Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya, part of Japan's Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, which bought it in 2016; it was a deposit-taking microfinance institution until it was licensed and renamed as a commercial bank in August 2020.

sources.title: TRIS Rating affirms company rating of Hattha Bank

KB PRASAC Bank.desc: KB PRASAC Bank Plc is a Cambodian commercial bank serving all customer segments, with a focus on communities and micro, small and medium enterprises. It launched on 7 August 2023 after PRASAC Microfinance Institution merged with Kookmin Bank Cambodia, is a subsidiary of South Korea's KB Financial Group, and at launch had US$5.7 billion in assets, 192 branches and more than 10,000 staff.

sources.title: KB PRASAC Bank Plc. Officially Launches, following the Merger between PRASAC MFI and Kookmin Bank Cambodia

LOLC (Cambodia) Plc.desc: LOLC (Cambodia) Plc is a Cambodian microfinance institution licensed by the National Bank of Cambodia, lending to small traders and farming families and taking savings and fixed deposits. In 2017 it was 60% owned by LOLC Micro Investment Ltd of Sri Lanka and 37% by Developing World Markets, with total assets of US$371 million, 210,227 borrowers, 76 branches and 2,065 staff.

Sathapana Bank.desc: Sathapana Bank Plc is a Cambodian commercial bank offering personal, business and digital banking and cash management. Its parent is MARUHAN Corporation of Japan; it was created in April 2016 by merging MARUHAN Japan Bank Plc with the microfinance institution SATHAPANA Limited, and began with 160 branches and 3,458 staff.

Karot Power Company Ltd (KPCL).desc: Karot Power Company Limited is a Pakistani project company set up to build, own and run the 720 MW Karot run-of-river hydropower plant on the Jhelum River, expected to generate about 3,174 GWh a year and sell all of it to the National Transmission and Despatch Company under a 30-year contract. It is 93% owned by China Three Gorges South Asia Investment Limited, the Pakistan investment arm of China's state-owned China Three Gorges Corporation.

Three Gorges Technology and Economy Deve.note: The only source opened that names the firm (Renewable Energy World on the Karot EPC award) calls it Yangtze Three Gorges Technology & Economic Development Co. and says it formed the winning consortium with China Machinery Engineering Corporation, but gives no description of its business or ownership. The IFC project summary does not mention it. No company site or Chinese corporate-register entry could be opened, so nothing could be said about what kind of firm it is.

Baynouna Solar Energy Company.desc: Baynouna Solar Energy Company owns and runs the 200 MW Baynouna solar park in Jordan, which produces over 560 GWh a year and sells its power to Jordan's National Electric Power Company. It is a joint venture of Masdar, a UAE-owned renewables company, and Taaleri, a Finnish investment and asset management group; the park was inaugurated in February 2023.

sources.title: Masdar's subsidiary Baynouna Solar Energy Company inaugurates 200MW Jordanian project

Indorama Eleme Fertilizer and Chemicals.desc: IEFCL is a Nigerian fertilizer maker at Port Harcourt that turns gas into urea, running two lines with a combined 2.8 million tonnes a year (the first completed in June 2016, the second in April 2021). Its sponsor is Indorama Corporation, a Singapore-based holding company wholly owned by S.P. Lohia and family.

PT Indo Raya Tenaga.desc: PT Indo Raya Tenaga is an Indonesian power company set up in 2017 to build and run the 2,000 MW Jawa-9 and 10 coal-fired units at Suralaya in Banten, using ultra-supercritical technology. It is a joint venture of PT Barito Wahana Lestari, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Barito Pacific group, and PT Putra Indotenaga, a subsidiary of PT Indonesia Power, itself part of the state electricity utility PLN.

sources.title: Barito, IP team up in 2x1000 MW power plant project

PT Bank KEB Hana Indonesia.desc: PT Bank KEB Hana Indonesia (Hana Bank) is a South Korean-owned commercial bank in Indonesia that lends to businesses and individuals and runs the LINE Bank digital service, which had 1.2 million customers at the end of 2024. It disbursed Rp37.1 trillion of credit and made Rp519.4 billion in net profit in 2024.

sources.title: Hana Bank posts Rp519 billion profit in 2024, a 14.61% increase

Lomé Container Terminal (LCT).desc: Lome Container Terminal is a Togolese company that owns and runs a container terminal in the Port of Lome, with a 1,050 m quay, a 16.6 m channel and nine quay cranes. At the time of IFC's 2011 investment it was indirectly wholly owned by Global Terminal Limited, a sister company of Terminal Investment Limited, and the terminal was estimated to handle up to 1.5 million containers a year.

Terminal Investment Limited (TIL).desc: Terminal Investment Limited (TiL) is a container terminal investor and operator based in Geneva, with terminals in 29 countries, among them Antwerp, Long Beach, Le Havre, Valencia, Singapore and Lome. Mediterranean Shipping Company held a 60% majority stake after a deal in May 2019 in which Singapore's sovereign fund GIC took 10%.

sources.title: MSC Increases Its Stake in TiL and Welcomes Singapore's GIC as a New Shareholder of TiL

Grupo M.desc: Grupo M SA is a Dominican apparel manufacturer founded in 1986 by Fernando Capellan, making knit and woven clothing for US brands including Liz Claiborne, Polo, Levi's, Hanes and Calvin Klein. Capellan, other family members and senior managers together hold 82% of the shares, with Grupo Popular among the other shareholders; an IFC summary of 2014 gave about 500 workers in the Dominican Republic and 7,500 in Haiti.

Compagnie de Développement Industriel (C.desc: CODEVI is the Haitian arm of the apparel maker Grupo M, which owns it outright, and runs a duty-free industrial zone at Ouanaminthe on the border with the Dominican Republic. Its payroll grew from 300 workers in 2006 to more than 7,000 by mid-2013, which the IFC described as making it Haiti's largest employer.

Agilis Partners.desc: Agilis runs Asili Farms in Uganda, growing maize, soybeans and sunflower by machine on about 7,500 hectares of owned and long-leased land in the Kiryandongo, Masindi and Amuru districts, and selling to regional food manufacturers and humanitarian organisations. It was co-founded by Benjamin Prinz, Philipp Prinz and Eduardo Browne, and has 225 permanent and 650 semi-permanent workers.

Procesadora Nacional de Alimentos (Prona.desc: Pronaca is an Ecuadorian food company that raises and processes chicken and pork, makes canned and processed meats, frozen foods and pet food, and grows palm heart, artichoke, rice and corn. Built up by its founding family, it had revenue of about US$945 million in 2014 and around 8,000 employees; in 2017 Guatemala's family-owned Corporacion Multi Inversiones agreed to buy a block of shares from that family.

sources.title: Procesadora Nacional de Alimentos C.A. project page

Aperam BioEnergia.desc: Aperam BioEnergia is the Brazilian forestry unit of the steelmaker Aperam, in Minas Gerais. It produces charcoal, wood, seedlings and seeds from eucalyptus forests whose management is certified by the Forest Stewardship Council.

Aperam S.A..desc: Aperam is a steelmaker producing stainless, electrical and specialty steel and recycling scrap, with sixteen production sites in Brazil, Belgium, France, the United States, India and China and customers in more than 40 countries. It reported sales of EUR 6,080 million and shipments of 2.29 million tonnes in 2025.

DP World Dakar S.A..desc: DP World Dakar S.A. is a Senegalese company, the local joint venture of DP World and the Autonomous Port of Dakar. It is investing US$837 million in the first phase of a new 600-hectare port and a further US$290 million in the second, on a site that includes a 300-hectare container terminal.

sources.title: DP World and Senegal sign agreement to develop Ndayane port

DP World.desc: DP World is a ports and logistics company whose businesses include ports and terminals, freight forwarding, contract logistics and economic zones. It has more than 126,000 employees, from 169 nationalities.

Adjaristsqali Georgia LLC (AGL).desc: Adjaristsqali Georgia LLC is a Georgian project company built to develop a run-of-river hydropower cascade of about 400 MW in Adjara, starting with the 178 MW Shuakhevi and 6 MW Skhalta plants. It is wholly held by the Dutch company Adjaristsqali Netherlands BV, which was in turn 40% owned by Clean Energy Invest, 40% by Tata Power and 20% by the IFC.

Tata Power International Pte. Limited.desc: Tata Power International Pte. Limited is a Singapore-incorporated investment holding and business consultancy company (registration 201309096C), wholly owned by The Tata Power Company Ltd of India, which is listed on the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges. It had total assets of US$500 million and a profit of US$25.0 million for the year to 31 March 2024.

sources.title: Tata Power International Pte. Limited financial statements 2023-24

Clean Energy Invest.desc: Clean Energy Invest was set up in February 2010 by the management team of Clean Energy Group to invest in hydropower projects in emerging markets, with Georgia its only market at the time. It is 70% owned by Norsk Mineral AS, a Norwegian family-owned industrial company, and 30% by that management team.

GN Power Dinginin Ltd..desc: GNPower Dinginin Ltd. Co. is a Philippine power company that owns a 1,336 MW coal-fired plant at Mariveles, Bataan, selling to 30 distribution utilities and two retail electricity suppliers. It is a limited partnership of AboitizPower's Therma Power, Inc., AC Energy Holdings, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Ayala Corporation, and Power Partners Ltd. Co.; construction of the first unit began in September 2016.

Masinloc Power Partners.desc: Masinloc Power Partners Co. Ltd. is a Philippine power company in Zambales that owns the 630 MW Masinloc coal-fired plant, a second 335 MW coal unit and a 10 MW energy storage project. In March 2018 SMC Global Power Holdings, the energy arm of San Miguel Corporation, completed a US$1.9 billion purchase of it, buying a 49% indirect interest from Thailand's EGCO Group and AES Corporation's 51% interest in its Philippine businesses.

sources.title: SMC Global Power completes $1.9-billion Masinloc acquisition

PT Gawi Makmur Kalimantan (PT Inti Selar.desc: PT Gawi Makmur Kalimantan is an Indonesian oil palm grower and miller in the Wings Group, made up of PT Inti Selaras Perkasa, PT Prima Tunas Kharisma and PT Sentosa Sukses Utama. In its 2017 report to the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil it listed 11 estates in South, Central and East Kalimantan, 33,274 hectares planted or built on out of 44,057 hectares controlled, three mills processing 60 tonnes of fruit an hour and one kernel crusher.

sources.title: PT Gawi Makmur Kalimantan Annual Communications of Progress 2017

PT Sayap Mas Utama (Wings Group).desc: PT Sayap Mas Utama is an Indonesian detergent maker, part of the Wings Group.

MHP (Myronivsky Hliboproduct).desc: MHP SE is an international food and farming company with its head office in Ukraine and its parent company in Limassol, Cyprus, producing chicken and processed meat, vegetable oil and crops, plus the Perutnina Ptuj business in Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina. Founded by Yuriy Kosyuk and listed on the London Stock Exchange (MHPC), it had revenue of US$3,046 million in 2024, produced 711,218 tonnes of poultry in Ukraine and employed over 36,000 people.

sources.title: MHP SE Financial Results Q4 and 12M 2024

Alto Maipo SpA.desc: Alto Maipo SpA is a Chilean project company set up to build a run-of-river hydroelectric scheme, and was a subsidiary of AES Andes (formerly AES Gener), which put in US$1,016 million of equity. It filed for Chapter 11 protection in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware on 17 November 2021, reporting assets and liabilities each between US$1 billion and US$10 billion, and AES Andes then removed it from its accounts with a net loss of about US$1.1 billion.

sources.title: New Chapter 11 Filing - Alto Maipo SpA
AES Andes informs on the reorganization process requested by Alto Maipo

AES Gener.desc: AES Gener was an electricity generating company in Chile, which the company described as the country's main generator, contributing 25% of the system's generation, and which also operated in Colombia. AES Corporation took part in a US$306 million capital increase in February 2021 and increased its shareholding; the company was renamed AES Andes at a special shareholders' meeting on 23 April 2021.

sources.title: AES Andes Reported a Solid Financial Performance and Consolidated its Transformation in the First Quarter of 2021

Desarrollo Turístico Bahía de Tela (DTBT.desc: Desarrollo Turistico Bahia de Tela is the Honduran company that holds the land for the Bahia de Tela (Los Micos Beach and Golf Resort) tourism development. It is 49% owned by the state Instituto Hondureno de Turismo and 51% by the Fondo Hondureno de Inversion Turistica, a group of 46 Honduran business people and national economic groups; the Instituto sold it 312 hectares in 2003 for US$19 million, and the private stage carried an estimated investment of about US$30 million.

sources.title: Turismo en Centroamerica: el nuevo escenario regional

Hidro Santa Cruz S.A..desc: Hidro Santa Cruz S.A. was a Guatemalan project company formed to build a small run-of-river hydroelectric plant of about 5 MW on the Canbalam river at Santa Cruz Barillas, at a cost of US$12.5 million. Its shares were held by two Spanish companies, Ecoener (85%) and Hidralia (15%), with Ecoener also the construction contractor; the group announced in December 2016 that it was leaving Guatemala.

sources.title: La empresa espanola Ecoener-Hidralia anuncia su retirada de Guatemala

Ecoener.desc: Ecoener is a Spanish renewable energy company that builds and operates small hydroelectric plants and other renewable projects. It listed on the Spanish stock exchange on 4 May 2021 under the ticker ENER, at a price of EUR 5.90 a share that valued it at EUR 336 million; Luis de Valdivia is its chief executive.

Corporación Interamericana para el Finan.desc: CIFI is a lender based in Panama City that structures, finances and syndicates loans for mid-sized infrastructure projects in Latin America and the Caribbean, and manages real-asset funds through CIFI Asset Management. Its shareholders are development finance institutions and multilaterals, international banks and its own executive team; at the end of 2025 it had a loan portfolio of US$339 million across 36 exposures and US$743 million of assets under management.

Axzon (now Goodvalley).desc: A Danish pig and crop group with its head office in Copenhagen and farms in Poland, Ukraine and Russia, which also runs a slaughterhouse, feed mills and nine biogas plants. Reporting as Goodvalley A/S, with shares and a EUR 135 million bond listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and 83.6% of its shares held by Polen Invest A/S and 6.9% by the IFC, it reported revenue of DKK 1,526 million, 34 farms, 38,300 hectares and 2,269 employees in 2019.

sources.title: Danosha (Goodvalley A/S) acquired 100% of Galician Agricultural Investments

Danosha (now Goodvalley Ukraine).desc: The Ukrainian pig-farming business of the Danish Goodvalley group, which also grows crops, makes feed and generates biogas and electricity in the Ivano-Frankivsk region; it is described as having wholly Danish capital and changed its name from Danosha on 16 March 2018. In 2019 it ran seven pig production units and about 18,500 hectares of crop land and sold 39,800 tonnes of live pigs, with segment revenue of DKK 429 million.

sources.title: Danosha (Goodvalley A/S) acquired 100% of Galician Agricultural Investments

Amalgamated Plantations Private Limited.desc: Amalgamated Plantations Private Limited is an Indian plantation company. It names Tata Global Beverages Pvt. Ltd., the International Finance Corporation and its own employees as its stakeholders, and says it is the only plantation company certified to the SA 8000 labour standard.

Bankers Petroleum Ltd..desc: Bankers Petroleum Ltd was a Canadian oil company with its corporate and technical headquarters in Calgary, which had operated Albania's Patos-Marinza oilfield since 2004 and held the Kucova field and Exploration Block F, with operational offices in Albania, Hungary and Romania. It reported a net loss of $3.6 million in 2015 after oil revenues halved, and in March 2016 affiliates of China's Geo-Jade Petroleum agreed to buy it in a deal valuing it at about C$575 million.

sources.title: China's Geo-Jade Petroleum buys Albania-focused Bankers Petroleum

Titan Cement Group.desc: Titan is a cement and building materials producer based in Greece, making cement, ready-mixed concrete and aggregates; a 2009 account gave it 12 cement plants and a presence in 12 countries, half of them emerging markets. Its holding company is listed on Euronext Brussels, the Athens Exchange and Euronext Paris under the ticker TITC, and it expected sales above EUR 2,640 million for 2024.

sources.title: Titan announces full year 2024 preliminary results

Alexandria Portland Cement Company (APCC.desc: Alexandria Portland Cement Company is an Egyptian cement maker, founded in 1948 and rebuilt in 2000, with a plant 5 km from the Mediterranean and capacity of 2 million tonnes of cement a year. It is listed on the Egyptian stock exchange and forms part of Titan's Egyptian operations.

Beni Suef Cement Company (BSCC).desc: Beni Suef Cement Company is an Egyptian cement maker, founded in 1993, whose plant lies about 120 km south of Cairo next to its raw materials, with capacity of 1.5 million tonnes a year and a second line planned to take it to 3 million. It forms part of Titan's Egyptian operations.

NewGlobe Schools, Inc. (Bridge Internati.desc: NewGlobe Schools, Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated education company whose wholly owned Kenyan subsidiary, Bridge International Academies, runs a chain of low-cost private schools for families earning under about US$2 a person a day, and which also licenses its teaching system to government school programmes. At the time of IFC's 2013-14 investment Bridge ran 211 schools with 57,000 pupils in Kenya; the company later reported reaching about 750,000 pupils, mostly through government contracts. The IFC exited in March 2022.

Corporación Montelimar S.A. (Navinic).desc: The company behind the Montelimar sugar mill at San Rafael del Sur, about 62 km from Managua, the smallest of Nicaragua's four sugar mills, crushing 2,300 tonnes of cane a day and producing about 33,000 tonnes of sugar a year before a planned expansion. The IFC project names Consorcio Naviero Nicaraguense S.A. (Navinic) as sponsor, majority-owned by the Fernandez Holmann and Morales families.

Eco Oro Minerals Corp. (formerly Greysta.desc: Eco Oro Minerals Corp is a precious-metals exploration and development company based in Vancouver and trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol EOM, whose wholly owned Angostura gold and silver deposit is in northeastern Colombia. It was called Greystar Resources Ltd until the name change took effect on 16 August 2011.

sources.title: Greystar Changes Name to Eco Oro Minerals Corp

Galnaftogaz (OKKO).desc: Concern Galnaftogaz is the Ukrainian company behind the OKKO network of filling stations and, as OKKO Group, controls more than ten other businesses, among them farming, natural gas trading and mineral fertilizers; its grain arm exported 500,000 tonnes in the marketing year before 2018. Vitaliy Antonov is its president and chairman of the supervisory board.

sources.title: Vitaliy Antonov among the top three managers of Ukrainian retail

Spie-Capag and Petrofac joint venture (S.desc: A construction joint venture of two companies, Spie Capag and Petrofac.

Arali.note: Searched for Arali alongside the BTC pipeline and Vale, Georgia, and opened the CAO's BTC Pipeline case page; the firm is not named there and no company register entry, company site or news report about a contractor of that name could be opened. The name is too generic to confirm an identity without guessing.

GMR Kamalanga Energy Limited (GMR Group).desc: GMR Kamalanga Energy Limited is an Indian power company in the GMR Group. Its coal-fired station in Odisha's coal belt was commissioned in phases from March 2013, is fuelled through Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of state-owned Coal India, and sells power under long- and medium-term contracts to GRIDCO in Odisha, Uttar Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam, Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation and the Bihar State Electricity Board.
